next_priority_live_log_proposal.browser: New isolated agent-browser session `qawebsecure20261010-live-log-38181`, allow only 127.0.0.1, open the loopback origin, no unsafe-origin/TLS/global permission flags. Abort unless exact origin and `isSecureContext===true`, clipboard APIs present, and session online. Use no previous logged-in session.
next_priority_live_log_proposal.clipboard_oracles: Get target’s actual browserContextId via Target.getTargets/Target.getTargetInfo and set permissions only for that context and exact loopback origin; local installed Chromium protocol types expose Browser.setPermission browserContextId and clipboardReadWrite/clipboardSanitizedWrite (and permission descriptors). Verify page permission state. Click the real Copy UI button. Page-side real navigator.clipboard.readText() compares exact text in memory; persist/emit only byte length, SHA-256 and equals-expected boolean. Then set real permission denied in the same context/origin and click real Copy again; record actual browser permission state and UI feedback, without mock clipboard. Restore by Browser.resetPermissions for that context, remove only test text if safely supported, clear session network history, logout unique session, close context.
next_priority_live_log_proposal.follow_oracle: Capture log-container scrollTop/clientHeight/scrollHeight. With Follow off, place viewport away from bottom and verify subsequent real log chunks do not force scroll-to-bottom; then enable Follow and verify a later chunk moves it to bottom. Record per-sample values/deltas and UI toggle state; do not claim based on control presence.
